mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.3 percentage points over 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing market activity (HOUST above 900,000 units) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 7.0%) indicates robust economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 900 and UNRATE < 7.0.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of zero interest rate policy (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 900,000 units) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 95) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth above 100,000 jobs) combined with robust housing starts (HOUST above 900,000 units) indicates broad-based economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100 and HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL above 232.0) signals persistent inflation, which may prompt the Fed to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5% and CPIAUCSL > 232.0.
